title_en: Response to Realize Capital Cost and Stock Price-Conscious Management (Update)
translation_en_brief:
General Packer announced an update to its capital cost-conscious management approach, setting specific financial targets for fiscal 2029 (ending July 2029). The company targets an operating margin on sales of 11.0%, ROA of 10.6%, and ROE of 10.8%, along with revenue of 14,000 million yen and net income of 1,047 million yen. These targets compare to actual fiscal 2026 results of 12.1% operating margin, 12.1% ROA, and 10.8% ROE, with revenue of 11,198 million yen and net income of 828 million yen.

The company's analysis found that while its ROE has remained stable above 10% over the past five years and shareholder numbers have grown, its PER stands at 8.0x and PBR remains below 1.0x as of fiscal 2026. Management attributes this valuation gap to insufficient market recognition of the company's long-term growth potential and competitive strengths. To address this, General Packer is implementing the 8th medium-term management plan focused on accelerating global expansion targeting 40% or higher overseas revenue ratio, developing new products suited to automation and environmental needs, expanding business domains through M&A and alliances, and enhancing human capital through revised personnel systems, including transition from competency-based to role-based grades and raising retirement age to 65.

The company aims to achieve PBR above 1.0x by improving profitability and capital efficiency while enhancing investor communication and disclosure of growth strategies and competitive advantages.
